snippet.title: Palworld 1.0 Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
🚨Palworld 1.0 - July 10th!

Pal Tamers, the time has come!
Palworld's first-ever cinematic trailer alongside the release date you have been waiting for!

Gather your Pals.
Palpagos awaits!
